candidates.meaning: Show the field names for each physicist.
candidates.sql: SELECT P.name, F.fieldName FROM Physicists P JOIN Physicist_Fields PF ON P.id = PF.physicistId JOIN Fields F ON PF.fieldId = F.id

candidates.meaning: Show a list of fields each physicist is associated with, including the physicist's name and the field names.
candidates.sql: SELECT P.name, F.fieldName FROM Physicists P JOIN Physicist_Fields PF ON P.id = PF.physicistId JOIN Fields F ON PF.fieldId = F.id

candidates.meaning: List all fields and for each field, show the physicists who are associated with it.
candidates.sql: SELECT F.fieldName, P.name FROM Fields F JOIN Physicist_Fields PF ON F.id = PF.fieldId JOIN Physicists P ON PF.physicistId = P.id

candidates.meaning: Display a list of unique fields and the physicists associated with each field, without repeating physicists for the same field.
candidates.sql: SELECT F.fieldName, P.name FROM Fields F JOIN Physicist_Fields PF ON F.id = PF.fieldId JOIN Physicists P ON PF.physicistId = P.id GROUP BY F.fieldName, P.name
